sentences: Wrapped in golden robes, two lovers embrace at the edge of a flowering meadow.
The son of a goldsmith, Klimt applied real gold leaf to create a glow like Byzantine mosaics.
The man's robe is filled with black and white rectangles; the woman's with round flowers and circles.
The two patterns overlap within one golden form, expressing the moment two people become one.
Realistic faces and hands coexist with flat ornament on the same surface.
Her toes curl over the very edge of the cliff, so ecstasy and danger are felt together.
The Austrian state bought it even before it was finished, and it has been beloved ever since.
